# Local OCR service

> A shared localhost service for PDF and image OCR with a persistent queue, per-app credentials, and optional MCP access.

Use `GET /health` for worker health, `GET /v1/pipelines` for engine
capabilities, `POST /v1/jobs` to submit, and `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` to poll
or retrieve the result. `GET /v1/workload` reports shared queue capacity and
job and storage counts for the authenticated app. Use Docling for PDFs.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Installation, pipelines and MCP setup.
- [Service and API guide](docs/shared-local-ocr.md): Authentication, examples, timeouts, limits and result retention.
- [Local OCR skill](.agents/skills/local-ocr/SKILL.md): Agent workflow for jobs, polling and private results.
- [MCP configuration](mcp.json): Local stdio adapter configuration.
